sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) AS applications FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.documents d ON d.case_id = c.case_id WHERE d.outcome = 'ask_applicant' AND c.status = 'approved' AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
explanation: Applications approved in Q3 2026 that had at least one ask_applicant, each counted once.
